title: Active project workspace
testKey: Click Overview, Tasks, and Notes and confirm the content changes. Then change the active project elsewhere; this panel should update its project name and note automatically.
html:
ACTIVE PROJECT

Project
js:
const projectName=p=>p?(p.name||p.title||String(p.id)):'No active project';const getProject=()=>{const ps=api.getState('projects')||[];const id=api.getState('activeProjectId');return ps.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(id))||ps[0]||null;};const projectTasks=p=>{const all=api.getState('tasks')||[];if(!p)return all;const scoped=all.filter(t=>t.projectId!=null&&String(t.projectId)===String(p.id));return scoped.length||!all.some(t=>t.projectId!=null)?(scoped.length?scoped:all):scoped;};const noteFor=p=>{const notes=api.getState('notes');if(!p||notes==null)return '';if(typeof notes==='string')return notes;if(Array.isArray(notes)){const hit=notes.find(n=>String(n.projectId||n.id)===String(p.id));return hit?(hit.text||hit.note||hit.content||''):'';}if(typeof notes==='object'){const direct=notes[p.id]??notes[String(p.id)]??notes[projectName(p)];if(typeof direct==='string')return direct;if(direct&&typeof direct==='object')return direct.text||direct.note||direct.content||'';}return '';};const render=()=>{const p=getProject();const tasks=projectTasks(p);const rawSection=api.getState('workspaceSection');const section=['Overview','Tasks','Notes'].includes(rawSection)?rawSection:'Overview';root.querySelector('[data-project-name]').textContent=projectName(p);root.querySelector('[data-project-status]').textContent=p?(p.status||'Ready'):'No project';root.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-current',b.dataset.section===section?'page':'false'));const body=root.querySelector('[data-workspace-body]');body.innerHTML='';if(section==='Overview'){const done=tasks.filter(t=>String(t.status||'').toLowerCase()==='done').length;const open=tasks.length-done;body.innerHTML='
Project tasks
Open
Done
';body.querySelector('[data-v=total]').textContent=tasks.length;body.querySelector('[data-v=open]').textContent=open;body.querySelector('[data-v=done]').textContent=done;}else if(section==='Tasks'){if(!tasks.length){body.innerHTML='

No shared tasks for this project.

';}else{const list=document.createElement('div');list.className='task-list';tasks.forEach(t=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='task-row';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=t.title||'Untitled task';const status=document.createElement('span');status.textContent=t.status||'Todo';row.append(title,status);list.appendChild(row);});body.appendChild(list);}}else{const note=noteFor(p);const para=document.createElement('p');para.className=note?'note':'empty';para.textContent=note||'No shared note for this project.';body.appendChild(para);}};root.querySelectorAll('[data-section]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{api.setState('workspaceSection',b.dataset.section);api.log(2,'Workspace section changed to '+b.dataset.section);}));render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
